provenance.character_tracks: EventSequenceDef.unk_00 is the exact character-track count: event_seq_1 loops j from 0 while j < count and passes track[j].unk_04 plus j into event_chara_0; event_chara_0 reads track[j].unk_00 as EventCharaKeyframe*. The two camera helpers likewise use this count. Each 8-byte track has a canonical keyframe pointer, character selector byte and three zero padding bytes. All scalar bytes and native counts match in every present region; EU omits the two independently established dummy events. No keyframe extent is inferred from these track bounds.
